Massage guns have come a long way, offering new ways to relieve muscle tension, manage soreness, and support recovery. Discover the latest techniques and upgrades that may help improve mobility, ease discomfort, and make the most of your recovery routine.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
